question: Rawatbhata Atomic Power Plant is located near which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kota**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Rawatbhata Atomic Power Plant**, also known as the **Rajasthan Atomic Power Station (RAPS)**, is located in the **Chittorgarh** district of **Rajasthan**, but it is geographically closest to the major city of **Kota**.
 
• The facility is situated near the **Rana Pratap Sagar Dam** on the **Chambal River**, which provides the necessary water supply for the cooling systems of the reactors.
 
• It was the first plant in India to adopt the **Pressurized Heavy Water Reactor (PHWR)** technology, which utilizes **Natural Uranium** as fuel and **Heavy Water (D₂O)** as a moderator and coolant.
 
• The construction of the first two units began in the **1960s** with technical assistance from **Canada** (Atomic Energy of Canada Limited), marking a significant milestone in India's nuclear energy program.
 
• The plant is operated by the **Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL)** and currently consists of multiple operational units, with additional units being planned or under construction to increase capacity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jaipur**:

 
 
• Recognized as the **Pink City**, it serves as the capital of **Rajasthan** and is a major hub for tourism and administrative activities, though it lacks nuclear infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Udaipur**:
 
 
• Known as the **City of Lakes**, it is famous for its historical palaces and artificial lakes like **Lake Pichola** and **Fateh Sagar Lake**.
 
 
 
• **Ajmer**:
 
 
• A central city in Rajasthan known for its religious significance, specifically the **Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Dargah** and the nearby holy town of **Pushkar**.
 
 
 
• **Nuclear Power in India**:
 
 
• India's nuclear energy strategy is a three-stage program aimed at utilizing the country's vast **Thorium** reserves.
 
• Other prominent nuclear power plants include **Tarapur** (Maharashtra), **Kudankulam** (Tamil Nadu), **Narora** (Uttar Pradesh), and **Kakrapar** (Gujarat).
